cover.title: Lisbon
cover.subtitle: One thing is still open before the 14th.
cover.label: open item

stories.hook: The rental car for Lisbon is still open.
stories.label: offers inside the budget
stories.body: Two offers are inside the budget you set in March. Both can be cancelled until the day before.

stories.hook: Everything else for the trip is booked.
stories.body: The host asked for the arrival time a day ahead, by message.

confirm.question: Did you tell the host when you arrive?

cover.title: Knee
cover.subtitle: Week 6 of the rehab, and it is going the right way.
cover.label: days done

stories.hook: Pain on the stairs is half of what it was.
stories.body: Eight days of notes. The line is what matters, not any single day.

quote.text: Stairs are fine going up; down only with the rail until week 8.

stories.hook: Eighteen of twenty-eight days are done.
stories.body: Two missed days so far, both on travel.

cover.title: Money
cover.subtitle: May closes a little over the plan.
cover.label: of the monthly budget

stories.hook: Spending is four points over last month.
stories.body: Most of it is the trip. Without it the month is under the plan.

cover.title: Bread
cover.subtitle: Session five of twelve is today.

stories.hook: Today: fold three times, forty minutes apart.
stories.body: The dough tells you when it is ready; the clock only suggests.
stories.next: Start the first fold after lunch.

stories.hook: No picture for this one, and it still has to look right.
stories.body: A card without an image keeps the tone of its topic, so it reads as a choice and not as a fault.
